title: Price List 2027: Spare Parts and Services

content.text: Price List 2027: Spare Parts and Services
Valid from [DATE_1] for customers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Issued by the After-Sales Service of [ORG_1], [ADDRESS_1].

This price list contains the most frequently ordered spare parts, wear part kits and service rates for the edge banding machines of the series EB 300, EB 500 and EB 700. It replaces the price list 2026 and all earlier versions. Parts that are not listed here are available on request; please send us the machine number and the part number from the spare parts catalogue of your machine.
in euros, excluding VAT, packaging and shipping. The net price applies per unit as stated in the table. For orders placed through the online
, customers receive an additional discount of 3 percent on the net price of all parts.

Compared to the previous year, prices for most parts have increased by an average of 4.2 percent. The main reasons are higher prices for steel, electronic components and energy. Prices for wear part kits have remained unchanged, because we were able to bundle our purchasing volumes for these parts.
The following conditions apply to all orders of spare parts and services:
The minimum order value is EUR 50.00 net. For smaller orders, we charge a handling fee of EUR 15.00.
Parts marked as stock items are shipped on the same working day if the order is received by 2:00 p.m.
For express shipping within Germany, we charge EUR 38.00 per parcel; for Austria and Switzerland, EUR 65.00.
Returns of unused parts in their original packaging are accepted within 30 days. We credit 80 percent of the net price; electronic components and parts made to order cannot be returned.
Exchange parts, such as motors and control units, are invoiced at the full net price. After we receive the old part in repairable condition, we credit the exchange value stated in the table.
general terms of delivery and payment

Many machines have been modified or upgraded since delivery, so the same position in the machine can require different parts depending on the year of construction. To avoid wrong deliveries, please always state the machine number, which you will find on the type plate on the left side of the machine frame and in the main menu of the control unit under "Machine information". With the machine number, our team can check the parts list of your individual machine, including all modifications that we have carried out.

The spare parts catalogue for your machine is available as a PDF in the customer area of our website and as an interactive catalogue in the spare parts shop. In the interactive catalogue, you can click on the part in an exploded drawing and add it directly to the shopping basket. If you cannot find a part, a photo of the part and of the type plate is usually enough for our team to identify it.
You can order spare parts in the following ways:
Through the online spare parts shop, which is available around the clock and shows the current stock level for each part.
Log in with your customer number and the password you received with your order confirmation.
Select your machine from the list of your registered machines, so that only matching parts are shown.
By email to the spare parts team, stating the machine number, the part numbers, the quantities and the delivery address.
By phone during the opening hours of the service hotline, for urgent orders and for questions about the right part.
Every order is confirmed by email with the expected delivery date. If a part is not in stock, the confirmation shows the expected delivery time, and we offer an alternative part if one is available.
The delivery time refers to working days from the receipt of the order at our warehouse. Parts with a delivery time of "stock" are kept in stock in our central warehouse.

Wear part kits contain all parts that should be replaced during the annual maintenance of the machine. They are cheaper than buying the parts individually and make sure that nothing is forgotten. Each kit comes with a checklist for the replacement.

Our service technicians install spare parts, carry out maintenance and repair machines at the customer's site. Travel time is charged at the same rate as working time. The rates apply to working days from Monday to Friday between 7:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
Surcharge for work after 6:00 p.m. and on Saturdays
Surcharge for work on Sundays and public holidays
Remote support by phone or remote access
Annual maintenance, fixed price including travel within 150 km

The fixed price for the annual maintenance includes up to 8 hours of working time, the travel costs and a written maintenance report. The wear part kits are invoiced separately at the net price shown above.
We grant the following discounts on the net price of spare parts. Discounts cannot be combined, with the exception of the online shop discount.

Discounts do not apply to service and labour rates, shipping costs or the exchange value of exchange parts.

Deliveries are made ex works from our central warehouse in [LOCATION_1]. The risk passes to the customer when the goods are handed over to the carrier. Invoices are payable within 30 days net; for payment within 10 days, we grant a 2 percent cash discount on the net price of parts. Service invoices are payable within 14 days without deduction.
For customers outside Germany, Austria and Switzerland, our international sales partners provide local price lists. Please contact us to find the responsible partner for your country.
